Skills.Name: Long Blades
Skills.Description: Mastery of swords — long, balanced edges that cut deep and bleed long.

Powers.Name: Lacerate
Powers.Description: Long-Blade hits have a substantial chance to apply Bleeding with stronger damage dice. Stacks with the universal Cutting class hook.

Powers.Name: Expertise
Powers.Description: +2 to-hit while wielding a Long-Blade-class weapon (LongSword / Greatsword / ShortSword / Claymore / etc.).

Powers.Name: Lunge
Powers.Description: Active ability: strike the first creature up to 2 cells along the chosen line with a normal long-blade attack, without moving. Walls and other solid objects block the reach. Cooldown 10; requires a LongBlades weapon.

Powers.Name: En Garde
Powers.Description: Raise your equipped long blade for 2 of your turns. Halve the next positive melee blow from an adjacent attacker, rounding the remaining damage up. One parry only; keep the sword equipped. Does not block spells, poison or environmental harm. Costs a turn; cooldown 12.

Powers.Name: Follow Through
Powers.Description: Strike the selected adjacent creature with a normal long-blade attack. If it dies, attempt an ordinary step into its former cell. Roots, blockers and traps still apply; a missed strike or blocked advance still costs the turn. Cooldown 12; requires an equipped long blade.
